correctness.rationale: Anchoring at the apex gives a compact polytope and strictly convex variance. A tight-edge perturbation shows that every maximizing vertex is integral, hence rim labels are -1,0,1. Exact variance numerator N(a+b)-(a-b)^2, one versus two zero separators, parity minimization of the sign difference, strict exclusion of one-sign profiles by N^2/4, and attainability prove both formulas and all equality cases. The parity edge gap is their exact difference. Checker exhaustively corroborates 3<=m<=10 with exact fractions; universal conclusions rely on the analytic proof.

No equivalent claim was recovered; residual unindexed and terminology risks remain.

value.rationale: Exact spread is the sharp variance constant controlling product-graph concentration rates in the foundational Alon–Boppana–Spencer setting. The fan and wheel are two canonical diameter-two graph families differing by exactly one edge. The theorem completes their all-order constants and all optimizer structures, identifies the necessary extra zero separator on cycle closure, and gives an explicit strictly positive parity-sensitive one-edge penalty of order 1/m; both approach the universal diameter bound at different sharp rates. This is a motivated natural complete classification, not an isolated finite computation or a renamed universal inequality.
